title: 3 A.M. Expressway
artist: 東都ナイト・アンサンブル
caption: 1980s neo-noir driving music, instrumental. A steady pulsing analog synthesizer bass sequence, dark sustained synth pads, glassy electric piano chords, a distant reverberant saxophone, restrained electronic drums. Cold, hypnotic, sodium lights passing overhead on an empty elevated highway. Spacious 1980s film score production. No vocals.
note: Preferred in the listening test (configuration B).
